opening.text: Every single position is green. All eight. Crypto value $1,376.50 on $1,086 deposited, up 26.8%, with the oldest holding only 24 days old. ZEC leads at +35.6%, from $939.05 to $1,273.81 in six days, on Grayscale's ZCSH ETF pulling roughly $463M and privacy leading every sector at +90% over 30 days. DOT ran +24.9% off a short squeeze and a 150% jump in XCM throughput. NEAR is up 14% today with NEAR Day tomorrow. This is what it looks like when the narratives land.

Robinhood confirms 8 of 8 positions with quantities matching the ledger to the decimal. Portfolio $1,378.37 total, $1,376.50 crypto. But the ledger said $46.60 buying power and the broker reports $1.87. That gap is today's real finding: there is no dry powder. Regime reads BTC $78,627, dominance 58.4% (under the 60% trigger but climbing), Fear and Greed 66 falling from 71, ETH/BTC 0.0317, total cap down 2.6%. Alts bled with ADA -6.9%, LINK -5.4%, DOT -5.3%, while ZEC +7.3% and NEAR +7.4% ran the other way. That divergence is rotation, not a broad bid.

No sell trigger fires: nothing worse than -15%, no unlocks inside seven days, dominance under 60, nothing sitting fourteen days dead. Fine. But two names are on the clock. LINK is at eleven days and only +2.4%, and it is $446 of cost basis, a third of the book, riding on Circle's Arc mainnet on Sep 16 where LINK is the official oracle with BlackRock, DTCC and Visa validating. ADA is five days in at +1.2% and led today's decline; flat on Sep 18 makes it dead money. And $1.87 of buying power means every position here is a hold by force, not by conviction.

The uncomfortable read: this book is up 26.8% because it was bought into a rally, not because eight theses were each correct. Greed at 66 and falling, cap down 2.6%, and the two winners are the two most crowded trades on the tape. ZEC has run 2,496% and just elbowed into the top ten by market cap; buying that story at this price is buying somebody else's exit. Sitting at +35.6% with no ability to add is not a problem, it is protection. The actual risk is not missing a buy today. It is funding the account tomorrow and chasing whatever ran hardest today.
